proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5232 *jījja is expressly a nursery family, with Hindi jījī/jijjī/jijī “elder sister” and Marathi jijī. The family link preserves that expressive status rather than asserting a unique inherited nursery-word origin. Joint comparison: Rathawi jiji “older sister” matches reviewed bundeli_atarra jījī “older sister” (f_qo4i4oe6cqnzk). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
